reviews.title: User Beware!!!
reviews.text:
To all potential users of Yoga Fit please be aware of this app and their free trial period!

I downloaded the Yoga Fit App and tried it for about two (2) days and decided that my previous yoga experience and exercises were redundant so I cancelled the service.

After the trial period ended Apple billed me for 39.00 dollars for a one (1) year subscription.   I filed an appeal with the Apple and supplied me information about cancelling within the one (1) week trial period.

Apple denied my request and basically calling me a liar.   Please note, when you file a complaint with the Apple Store you are NOT given an opportunity to support any documentation as it’s your word against their service.  

Please note, we are dedicated Apple fans and customers as we have been buying Apple computers for many, buying Apple iPhones for many years, using Apple TV, and have purchased various apps with no problems until trying the Yoga Fit App.

There were times that we were charged for Apple services but never applied for that service so Apple representatives returned our funds because we did not use a specific service.   

Life is a lesson and lesson of trial and error, but in this situation with the Yoga Fit App and the automatic charging us $39.00 dollars for just accepting the free trial period is a lesson learned.  

The lesson learned is that app trail periods may not be as they advertise, as your cancellation within the allotted time period is ignored and you are billed for a year of ser

reviews.title: This app has changed
reviews.text:
This app used to be great. I used to use it all the time. It was truly a great app with mostly free content and the OPTION to have a subscription. I stopped using it when I got a dislocated knee and then started again about a year later to find that they paywalled about half the content behind the subscription. It was still okay at that point, plenty of free stuff to do and follow, more comprehensive workouts and poses. Another knee injury and surgery happen and another year or so passes. I finally get back to the app and THE ENTIRE APP is a paid subscription.

This is no longer "Yoga For Beginners", no longer the app everyone online recommends when you ask them for a good yoga app. I understand that as platforms get bigger, they cost more to maintain. But the ENTIRE app was built around its ACCESSIBILITY for people and now it's only accessible if you have the money to spare. 

Find other apps or watch YouTube videos. Don't waste your time or money here.
